tasks.title: Fix the 'Class App\Http\Controllers\API\Bus not found' bug in this repo (project root). Root cause: app/Http/Controllers/API/AjaxSupportController.php has the facade import commented out on line 25 (// use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Bus;) but the progress() method (around line 1708) calls Bus::findBatch($bid), so PHP resolves Bus to App\Http\Controllers\API\Bus which does not exist. Fix: uncomment the import so it reads `use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Bus;` (keep the surrounding commented lines as they are). Verify: run php -l app/Http/Controllers/API/AjaxSupportController.php (must report No syntax errors) and confirm with a grep that the use statement is now active (not commented). Do not change anything else in the file. Report the exact line changed and the php -l result.

Fix the 'Uncaught TypeError: minDate() Could not parse date parameter' error on /excelreport/create in this repo (project root). Root cause: resources/js/modules/excelreport/form.js binds '.on(datetimepicker dp.change dp.update)' on the from and to pickers, and the dp.update event fires immediately on page load when the input is still empty - so $('#to1').datetimepicker('minDate', $('#from1').val()) is called with an empty string, which the pc-bootstrap4-datetimepicker library cannot parse and throws. Compare with the sibling resources/js/modules/attendancereport/form.js which only binds 'dp.change' (fires on user change, not on init) and is safe. Fix in excelreport/form.js: guard both handlers so minDate/maxDate are only set when the source value is non-empty, e.g. `var fromVal = $('#from1').val(); if (fromVal) { $('#to1').datetimepicker('minDate', fromVal); }` for the from picker handler, and the equivalent for the to picker maxDate. Keep the bootstrapValidator revalidateField calls unconditional. Do not change the datetimepicker init options. Verify: php artisan view:cache still compiles (no blade changes, so just confirm the JS edit is syntactically valid - you can run node --check resources/js/modules/excelreport/form.js or npx mix which must compile the bundle cleanly). Report the exact lines changed and the verification result.

Verify the two excelreport fixes in this repo (project root) end to end. Steps: (1) confirm app/Http/Controllers/API/AjaxSupportController.php has an ACTIVE (non-commented) `use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Bus;` import and that php -l passes on it; (2) run the full PHP test suite `php artisan test` - must stay green (baseline: 47 passed / 159 assertions); (3) run `npx mix` (Node available) and confirm the JS bundle compiles cleanly - this picks up the excelreport form.js edit; (4) confirm the route for the progress endpoint resolves: run `php artisan route:list` and grep for the progress route name - it must list the route with the API controller; (5) report the exact outputs. If any step fails, report the defect with exact error text per the test report contract.
